verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query Pulumi Cloud stacks and resources, search cloud resources, generate infrastructure code, and delegate tasks to Neo. The docs name supported clients (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Claude Desktop), and a probe confirmed the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that connecting an agent via the MCP server works in practice.
